column2: Memory and log in the sheet
the sheet is the main storage — turn on sign-in with confirmation
the vault is no more secure than the phone itself

Open IZIDAY in Safari on a Mac or a new iPhone with the same Apple ID and connect the app with the code from the widget. The vault opens with Face ID or Touch ID: the key comes via iCloud “Passwords”. Without iCloud — with the recovery code.
The log is stored in the app with a copy in the sheet (the “Log” sheet, encrypted). Entries older than 90 days are deleted automatically.
